issues.where: the whole globe across the landing beat, frames 2880-2902 and continuing through every later sheet
issues.what: the globe is pixel-static from the first frame: no settle, no bounce, no tilt decay, no base wobble after the set down, and the spilled snow and reflection never answer; a heavy thing landing reads as a cut to a still
issues.fix: give the landing a small fast compression and one or two decaying rocks of the sphere in the collar, with the base, reflection and loose snow responding, settling to rest over the first half second

issues.where: the interior from 48.00 s through about 49.40 s, as the storm clears
issues.what: the winter scene sits fully formed behind the fog from the first frame and is simply wiped on as the mist thins; the liquid never behaves like particles - no slam, no fold into a storm, no slow single whirl that dies away - it is a uniform milky fog doing an opacity fade
issues.fix: build the arrival out of discrete dense flakes that churn, rotate as one slowing vortex and thin unevenly, and let the new season grow in (snow gathering on the tree, roof and ground) rather than being revealed by a fading cloud

issues.where: the falling snow inside the globe, most visible once the scene is clear from 50.00 s on
issues.what: flakes drift down nicely at several depths but vanish at the bottom of the sphere instead of coming to rest on the ground, roof or branches, so nothing ever accumulates
issues.fix: let a share of the flakes land and hold on the surfaces they meet, with a faint build-up over the settling seconds

issues.where: the frost feathering on the lower-left glass, frames 3048-3058
issues.what: the frost edge creeps and recedes slightly between frames, a low-level crawl in what should be a locked-off detail
issues.fix: freeze the frost mask after the arrival or drive it with one slow monotonic growth so it never jitters
